script_text: Aquarius, this week the cosmos is about to flip your world upside down in the most unexpected way. Early in the week, Mercury forms a powerful trine with your ruling planet Uranus in your 1st House, sparking brilliant ideas and sudden breakthroughs on Monday and Tuesday — but watch for miscommunications Wednesday when Mercury squares Mars, making it your most frustrating day. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday as Venus enters your 7th House of partnerships, bringing a magnetic shift in how others see you. By Friday and through the weekend, that Venus energy creates a stunning sextile with Jupiter in your 10th House, opening a major career opportunity you didn't see coming. In love, Venus in your 7th House means someone from your past could reach out with real intention. Wednesday is your worst day due to that Mercury-Mars square causing tension, but Friday is your absolute power day because Venus and Jupiter align for career breakthroughs. Trust your intuition this week, Aquarius — your air element is electrified. Follow for daily updates.
